mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% signals a strong accommodative monetary policy stance, which typically leads to increased liquidity in the markets and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the accommodative signal, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS and SPX returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points within a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between UNRATE changes and SPX returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in real estate sales (HOUST) signals a weakening demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of broader economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 55% of periods with declining HOUST, or the correlation between HOUST and SPX returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals strengthening economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the correlation between INDPRO changes and SPX returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is above 8% and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) decrease by more than 100,000 in a month, it signals a significant labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 8% and PAYEMS falls > 100k in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the joint effect of UNRATE and PAYEMS on SPX returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 2% in a month, coupled with a rise in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 0.5%, signals stagflationary pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS falls > 2% and CPIAUCSL rises > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 55% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the joint effect of RSAFS and CPIAUCSL on SPX returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) rises by more than 0.5% in a month, it signals tightening monetary conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL rises > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the joint effect of FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL on SPX returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in GDP (GDPC1) by more than 2% in a quarter signals strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, especially in a regime of low inflation.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the correlation between GDPC1 growth and SPX returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during low inflation periods.
